description: jev-router: score each spawn_agent dispatch with Jev and pick a model for it. Copy to ~/.codex/hooks.json, or merge the PreToolUse group into the one already there, and replace the command with the absolute path to your clone. ./install.py --codex does both for you. Declaring the same hook here and in config.toml registers it twice and routes every dispatch twice; pick one file. The matcher is a regex on purpose: a bare `spawn_agent` is compiled as an exact string, and the V2 backend hands over the namespace and the name run together (`collaborationspawn_agent`), so an exact matcher never fires.
